businessModel: Donations and sponsorships; no ads or paid tiers
updateCadence: Frequent minor releases (12.18.1 on Sept 23, 12.21.0 on Oct 27)
summary: Japanese Firefox fork with vertical tabs, workspaces, split view, panel sidebar, custom CSS and, since 12.11, installing Chrome Web Store extensions. Also adds MCP server support. Desktop only (iOS beta announced).
bestFor: Firefox users who want vertical tabs and workspaces
People who want both Firefox add-ons and Chrome Web Store extensions
notFor: People who want a long-established team
Anyone who needs an Android app

pros.title: Firefox add-ons plus Chrome extensions
pros.detail: Since 12.11 (March 2026) the Chrome Web Store shows an Add to Floorp button, with some API gaps.

pros.title: Rich layout tools
pros.detail: Vertical tabs, workspaces, split view, panel sidebar and multi-row layouts are built in.

pros.title: Full MV2 uBlock Origin
pros.detail: Firefox engine keeps MV2 add-ons working.

pros.title: Fast release pace
pros.detail: Versions 12.18.1 to 12.21.0 shipped within five weeks.

cons.title: Chrome extension support is partial
cons.detail: Some extensions fail due to API differences (e.g. capture APIs); a warning says they are not Mozilla-vetted.

cons.title: No Android app
cons.detail: Only an iOS/iPadOS beta was announced in August 2026.

cons.title: Small team
cons.detail: Developed by a small Japanese group; long-term support depends on it.

faq.a: Yes, since Floorp 12.11 (March 2026), though some extensions do not work because of API differences.

faq.q: Is Floorp based on Firefox ESR?
faq.a: No, since 12.1.0 it returned to the rapid-release Firefox base after a period on ESR.
An iOS/iPadOS beta was announced in August 2026; there is no Android release.

longevity: Small team but steady releases since 2021
ai: MCP server integration, no built-in assistant
beginnerFriendly: Many options; press called it beginner-unfriendly
